title: The Plate-Breaker's Sling Method
summary: Teaches full-meridian slingers to put hard spun bullets through mail seams and visors and finally through plate.

title: Rapid Casting Under Pressure: A Treatise on Volley Fire from One Sling
summary: A treatise on keeping one sling in continuous cycle so volleys of stones fall on a crowd without a pause.

title: Treatise on the Field-Borne Shot
summary: Teaches a Xiantian slinger to spread qi as a field about the stone and steer it after release.

title: Heavy Shot Beyond the Horizon: Long-Range Casting
summary: A study of casting heavy bullets across valleys and ridges with long cords and a field-lofted release.

title: Paired Stones of the Azure Basin
summary: Teaches a slinger to fly two matched stones as a pair so that the second arrives where the first has opened a way.

title: River-Basin Dual-Track Sling Treatise
summary: A treatise on working two cords and two tracks at once so stones come from different angles to one mark.

title: The Hawk's Descent: Falling Shot Method
summary: A method for throwing from height so the stone falls like a stooping hawk onto one head or a wide crowd.

title: Plateau Edge Casting: A Slinger's Book of Bearings
summary: A book of bearings and drift corrections for slingers who throw from plateau edges in steady gusts.

title: The Wind-Sworn Cast: Oath of the Open Release
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn slinger to cast with the wind and swear each release to the open sky.

title: Gale Line Volleys: A Manual for the No-Walls Skirmish
summary: A manual of loose-line volleys and running barrages for slingers who fight on open ground with no walls to hold.
